title: Reconfiguration graphs of $K_{2,3}$-minor-free graphs
summary: The $\ell$-reconfiguration graph of a graph $G$, denoted by $\mathcal{R}_{\ell}(G)$, is the graph whose vertices are the proper $\ell$-colorings of $G$, with an edge between two colorings if they differ in color on exactly one vertex. For any graph $G$ of treewidth at most $2$, Bousquet and Perarnau showed that $\mathcal{R}_\ell(G)$ has linear diameter for $\ell\geq 6$. This result was later extended by Bartier, Bousquet, and Heinrich, who proved that $\mathcal{R}_5(G)$ also has linear diameter.
